# Geehy SDK subset

This directory contains the active-build subset of APM32F0xx SDK V1.8.7:

- CMSIS Core headers.
- APM32F0xx device headers, system source and APM32F072 GCC startup.
- Standard peripheral headers and RCM, CRS, FMC, GPIO, CAN, USB and USB Device
  sources.
- APM32 USB Device Core and CDC class middleware.
